name: Nadia
source:
"Nadia is the talkative secretary of Daikon Industries. She's usually the first person I see when I clock in, as she works in the lobby. She's bubbly and cheerful by nature, and very popular in the office. And she also happens to have control of keys and passwords that grant access to any room in the building..."

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dragonfirestudios/netghost/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
